title: Golden Plateau: events and people from original records
method: Every sentence of the Queensland Heritage Register entries matched to this mine (by name), plus sentences in other mining entries that name the mine, typed by fixed rules (lib/events.mjs). Quoted word for word with the record ID; nothing summarised. Each event is a capsule signed on its own (Ed25519 over canonical JSON); verify one with lib/sign.mjs verifyDoc(capsule.finding, capsule.attestation).
gaps: No Queensland Heritage Register entry tells this mine's story, and no other mining entry names it: events and people are not established from this register. Trove newspapers and mining journals are the next source.
Political connections and donations are not in the register; not established.
